why_model_is_useful: The model predicts hourly EV charging demand by zone, creating the demand signal needed for grid stress detection and scheduling decisions.

recommendation_logic.grid_stress: Model-predicted EV load is added to base grid load and compared with transformer capacity.
recommendation_logic.scheduling: High and Critical evening load is shifted to off-peak hours only where the post-shift load stays below 90% of transformer capacity.
recommendation_logic.station_planning: Zones are ranked using EV demand, growth, charger gap, traffic, grid spare capacity, grid health, stress, and overload counts.

explainability_examples.message: Evening peak, zone type, EV count estimate, traffic score, and base grid load explain why predicted demand rises in residential and mixed zones.
Jayanagar is highlighted because predicted total load reaches a high share of transformer capacity during critical hours.
Critical risk reduces from 98 to 47 after shifting flexible charging to feasible off-peak windows.
Hebbal is prioritized because the zone combines demand need with grid-aware feasibility for new charging infrastructure.
